purpose: Packet-owned INJECTIVE byte contract for eventDigest (AC2). The PR implements exactly this and may not choose an alternative. v2 fixes four non-injectivity defects found in v1.
construction: digest = SHA256( utf8(domainSeparator) || 0x00 || concat over fieldOrder of encodeField(field) )

encodeField.rule: encodeField(f) = presenceByte(f) || lenBE32(nameBytes) || nameBytes || lenBE32(valueBytes) || valueBytes
encodeField.presenceByte: 0x01 when the field is present, 0x00 when a declared-optional field is absent; when absent, valueBytes is empty. This makes absent and empty-present distinguishable, which v1 did not.
encodeField.requiredFieldAbsent: a required field that is absent is a typed reject, never encoded as absent

fieldOrder.name: timestamp
fieldOrder.grammar: the exact stored canonical UTC string, byte-identical to what is persisted; no re-normalisation, no re-formatting, no timezone conversion

fieldOrder.name: attemptId
fieldOrder.rationale: present on the current target event record; included because two attempts producing otherwise-identical bytes are distinct facts

fieldOrder.name: payload
fieldOrder.rationale: the exact stored bytes; never decoded, re-encoded, re-ordered or normalised

excludedFields.name: causationId
excludedFields.reason: delivery envelope metadata, not event identity

excludedFields.name: correlationId
excludedFields.reason: delivery envelope metadata, not event identity

excludedFields.name: executedUser
excludedFields.reason: delivery envelope metadata, not event identity

excludedFieldsRule: The exclusion list is CLOSED. A field present on the event record but absent from both fieldOrder and excludedFields is a typed reject, so silent omission is impossible.

tagSetEncoding.rule: sort ascending by UTF-8 byte order, remove exact duplicates, then encode as concat over elements of ( lenBE32(elementUtf8) || elementUtf8 ). Each element is individually length-prefixed.
tagSetEncoding.v1Defect: v1 joined elements with a U+001F separator and no per-element length prefix, so the two-element set [a, b] and the one-element set whose single element is a-U+001F-b both produced the same bytes 61 1F 62. Per-element length prefixing removes that collision without relying on any character being forbidden in a tag.

rawBytes.rule: the stored payload bytes are used verbatim as valueBytes; no UTF-8 round trip is performed
rawBytes.v1Defect: v1's construction sent every field through lengthPrefixedUtf8 while the payload rule demanded exact stored bytes - a contradiction. valueBytes is now typed per field.

conflictRule: Two writes sharing eventIdentity = (serviceId, eventId) but differing in eventDigest are a typed conflict, rejected fail-closed. Never merged, never last-writer-wins.

goldenVectors.requirement: The PR commits golden vectors with the exact expected lowercase hex digest for each case below, computed by the implementation and verified by an INDEPENDENT re-implementation in the checker (not the same serializer). Relation-only fixtures are insufficient because a shared faulty serializer would satisfy them.
cases: tag containing a supplementary-plane character (outside the BMP)
tag containing a U+001F unit-separator character (the v1 collision case)
two tags whose concatenation equals another single tag, proving no collision
payload that is not valid UTF-8 (raw bytes)
optional field absent versus optional field present-but-empty, proving distinct digests

requiredNegativeFixtures: same identity, payload byte changed -> conflict
same identity, declaredTagSet reordered -> SAME digest (canonical sort)
same identity, declaredTagSet with an exact duplicate entry -> SAME digest (dedup)
same identity, declaredTagSet with one extra tag -> conflict
same identity, a field present on the record but in neither fieldOrder nor excludedFields -> typed reject
different identity, identical remaining fields -> two distinct rows, no conflict
